title: Mucjisada Caddeynta Aamusnaanta
intro: Waxaad la kulantaa sheeko qarsoon oo ku saabsan faragelinta rabbaaniga ah. Sheeko ku saabsan bixinta mucjisada ah iyo difaac aan hadal lahayn oo soo noqnoqonaya waqti ka dib. Ma ogaan kartaa cidda la kulantay tijaabadan aan caadiga ahayn?
clues: Waxaan helay farriin rabbaani ah oo iga yaabisay
Dadkaygu waxay su'aal geliyeen daahirnimadayda markii aan ilmo la soo laabtay
Waxaa la i faray inaan soomo hadalka muddo ah
Il biyo ah iyo timir ayaa i quudiyay intii aan socday tijaabadaydii
Sayidkaygu wuxuu sameeyay geed ruxitaan mucjiso ah si uu ii quudiyo
Malaa'ig ayaa ii muuqatay iyadoo qaab nin qumman ah

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Dhalmo kaligaa ah oo geed timireed hoostiisa ku dhalata
In lagu tuuro god dab ah
Ka cararidda taliye kaligii talis ah
trial.answer: Dhalmo kaligaa ah oo geed timireed hoostiisa ku dhalata

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Dembi la'aantayda waxaa la caddeeyay markii wiilkayga yar uu hadlay
Dadkayga waxaa ku burburiyay ciqaabta rabbaaniga ah
Ceel mucjiso ah ayaa si joogto ah u soo muuqday
outcome.answer: Dembi la'aantayda waxaa la caddeeyay markii wiilkayga yar uu hadlay

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
